newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HCDL says too early to decide on Furama stake.
newsitem.headline: HCDL says too early to decide on Furama stake.

text.p: Wharf Holdings unit Harbour Centre Development Ltd (HCDL) said on Friday it was too early to say whether it would accept an offer for its holdings in Furama Hotel Enterprises Ltd.

Lai Sun Development Co Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to buy a 45.42 percent stake in Furama Hotel for HK$3.13 billion and would make a general offer for remaining shares in the company at HK$33.50 per share cash.
Harbour Centre owns about 23 percent of Furama. It said it had not participated in talks regarding the takeover bid.
"Therefore, it is premature at the present stage for the HCDL group to consider whether or not it would accept any offer for its interests in Furama," it said in a statement.
Trading in shares of Harbour Centre was suspended on Thursday and was due to resume on Friday.
The stock last traded at HK$12.75.
Wharf Holdings is controlled by Wheelock and Co Ltd.
